name: @balanceframe/scenario-kit
description: Typed feature scenarios and isolated Actual seed inputs

scripts.build: tsc && node --input-type=module -e "import { mkdirSync, copyFileSync } from 'node:fs'; mkdirSync('dist/protocol/fixtures/scenarios', { recursive: true }); for (const name of ['household', 'merchant']) copyFileSync('../../protocol/fixtures/scenarios/' + name + '.json', 'dist/protocol/fixtures/scenarios/' + name + '.json');"
